all_of: a Node/Next.js API route reads a query parameter and builds a filesystem path from it
the route validates the parameter with a string-oriented check
the route appends a fixed suffix to the path
any_of: the id is validated with a multiline regex
the traversal check uses Array.includes or another exact-match test
the final path is truncated to a fixed length

chain.action: request the id endpoint with a valid and a missing value; the ENOENT error reveals the path template team/<id>.png
chain.why: the error text names the exact file path the server tries to open

chain.action: send the parameter twice so the framework turns the query value into an array
chain.why: a string check coerces the array while an Array.includes check does not

chain.action: make the first array element a numeric line so the multiline regex matches, and the second element the traversal path
chain.why: the regex sees the comma-joined string, the includes check sees exact elements

chain.action: shape the traversal so the joined path reaches the fixed truncation length and ends at the target file
chain.why: the forced suffix is appended after the target and is removed by the slice

chain.action: read the flag file and ignore the misleading image content type
chain.why: the body is the file contents regardless of the declared type

first_confirming_probe.request: GET /api/team?id=1 then GET /api/team?id=99999 and read the error
first_confirming_probe.expected: a valid id returns image/png; a missing id returns an ENOENT error naming the constructed path
first_confirming_probe.falsifier: the parameter is not used to build a filesystem path, or the error is opaque

blast_radius: read-only file disclosure; no writes and no shared state is modified, so the chain is safe to run once per target

verification.evidence: HTTP 200 from /api/team whose body was the flag read from /flag.txt on the live target

reuse_when: a Node/Next.js route validates a query parameter as a string but the framework can deliver an array
a multiline regex or an Array.includes traversal check guards the value
a fixed-length slice removes a forced path suffix
known_traps: a direct traversal string is rejected; the duplicate-parameter array form is required
path.join prefixes the base directory, so the traversal must climb out of it
the forced suffix must fall past the truncation offset; use /proc/self/root style links to pad the path length
the response content type is image/png even when the body is text
